svg.title: TOPAK E2 — Observer liveness is progress, not presence: live(o), the K window, and what clocks may decide
svg.desc: ADR-0039 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.29, Batch 14, C4; A1 ratified Batch 20) couples Run's effect-bearing admits and Build's promotion gate to a live, keeping-up cell Observer, never to the correlator. ADR-0042 §2 makes the sequence count effects. ADR-0032 says why a local clock may be used for this and for nothing that preserves authority. Every clause subtracts; no Observer judgment enters the admit path.
svg.text: TOPAK · E2

text.tspan: Observer liveness is progress, not presence:
window, and what clocks may decide

svg.text: ADR-0039 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.29, Batch 14, C4; A1 ratified Batch 20) couples Run's effect-bearing admits and Build's promotion gate to a live, keeping-up cell Observer, never to the correlator. ADR-0042 §2 makes the sequence count effects. ADR-0032 says why a local clock may be used for this and for nothing that preserves authority. Every clause subtracts; no Observer judgment enters the
admit path.

text.tspan: Accepted · ADR-0039 · C4 · B14, A1 at B20
Draft, not ratified · the floor and its values file
§1 · The heartbeat and two values in mechanism state

svg.text: Heartbeat: an observer seat's fixed-schema fact with two fields, the watched round topic and its watermark, the sequence number through
which it says it has read. A fact, not a finding: it says nothing about what was read. Carried by Report in Run (ADR-0043 §4), Emit in Build.
heard(o): the mechanism's local monotonic time at which it last admitted a heartbeat under o's live lease. Per replica, as lease expiry is; never
the Observer's timestamp (ADR-0032 §3).
mark(o, r): the latest watermark for the Thinker's round r. Replicated from the log, and monotone: a falling watermark is refused. Kept per
seat, not per lease, so the Observer's next lease continues where it left off (R1).
1. o holds a live lease.
2. fewer than T_obs have elapsed since heard(o), read with ADR-0032 §2's asymmetric margin (elapsing early).
3. seq(t) − mark(o, r) < K for t's current round r. Strict, because the admit being decided counts: after it, at most K of the round's effects are
unread. ≤ K admits a K+1 backlog, which Coupling.tla found (R4, applied at R5).
Computed by the typed lift from mechanism state and handed to the floor as context.observerLive: a syntactic lift (ADR-0007).
At apply, the deterministic half is re-checked: conditions 1 and 3. An Observer whose lease ended, or whose watermark fell behind, between
decide and commit voids the admit (R5).
Condition 2 is checked at decide only: it is a per-replica clock, as lease expiry is. A heartbeat gone stale in that window is caught at the next
admit.
K < R is required and refused at startup for each domain: with K ≥ R condition 3 never refuses what the round bound has not (the ground on
which ADR-0026 R3 was withdrawn). It is not a premise of the bound: the unread bounds are proved for every K and R; K < R is what lets
condition 3 refuse at all (ADR-0046 §5). The gate-side K < R check is not realized (G8 item 46).
K = 0 admits nothing until the quarantine hold exists (finding 1; G7 item 48).

text.tspan: Why a local clock may decide this

svg.text: Expiry of liveness subtracts: a stale heartbeat refuses an admit. ADR-0032 §2 lets a subtracting interval run on a local monotonic clock
with a margin that errs early.
Clock error therefore costs availability (an early refusal), never an admit the envelope forbids (ADR-0032 §1).

text.tspan: Where liveness is coupled, and where it is not
Run: every effect-bearing admit under a Thinker (§2, A1)

svg.text: Floor entry R3-observer-live: forbid Actuate and Report when principal.kind == "thinker" and
!context.observerLive. In the genesis floor, which is DRAFT (G7 §2.2).
Needs live(o) for at least one cell Observer in the cell (any-of).
Not Consult (ADR-0041 §2): a read of pinned content adds nothing to the backlog and can be
reconstructed from its digest; a lagging Observer leaves its Thinker able to read and unable to act.
Not an Observer's own emissions, or R3 would refuse the heartbeat it exists to receive.
Denied locally, no consensus, attributed to the Thinker's lease; the Thinker waits, it is not evicted.

text.tspan: Run: coverage carries across rounds, at the grant (§2, R1)
is granted only if a cell Observer's

svg.text: A grant-path check, not a floor entry: the floor evaluates actions and a grant is not one.
At the grant, not the first admit, so a waiting Thinker holds no lease and burns no TTL.
Why: seq and the watermark restart with each lease, so the first draft passed at the start of every round;
within a round R bounds the backlog, across rounds nothing did (finding 4, M_ROUNDS).

text.tspan: Build: couples the gate, not each admit (§3)
A promotion completes only if the author's cell Observer has a watermark at or beyond the seal of

svg.text: the author's round topic set (ADR-0024 A2.3).
Coverage is not a "no finding" attestation (ADR-0024 §2 forbids that): objection is still only Vote(deny),
and silence is still not a veto.
Withholding coverage stalls the promotion and adds nothing.
No cross-round rule: Build's only egress is promotion, which already requires coverage.
No admit and no promotion waits on a correlator: coupling to it would make one seat's liveness a
precondition for every admit in its domain, the fleet-wide stall ADR-0038 exists to avoid.
It heartbeats too, so its absence is visible; that visibility is all this record gives it.
Its absence costs cross-cell detection: D-0038-2.
Coupling.tla CorrelatorNeverGates holds; M_CORR breaks it.

text.tspan: ADR-0042 §2 · The sequence counts effects (Accepted, B20)

svg.text: seq(t) is the number of Actuate and Report admits applied under t's lease in its current round, assigned at apply so every replica assigns the same number. Consult does not advance it.
The round bound R counts every admit, Consult included: a termination bound (ADR-0022 §3).

Every Actuate leaves a record on the round topic, written by the mechanism when the call returns (seat, fence, admit, seq, tool, breakGlass, inputs, outcome, result), so the Observer has something to mark (§3).
The seal counts every effect (§5).

Why (Context): the reference had counted emissions only. A Thinker that never reported could invoke up to R (64) unread, not K (8), and its round sealed at zero, so coverage across rounds was vacuous. RunCoupling.tla
's M_EMITSEQ is that reference: it breaks UnreadEffectsBounded and SealCountsEffects. Closed in the reference at 1e6c0c4 (ADR-0033 A3).

text.tspan: §2, §5 · What this bounds, and what it does not

svg.text: Bounded: at any moment at most K of a Thinker's effects, all in its current round, are unread by an Observer that has reported in within T_obs, because every earlier round was read to its seal. The first
mechanism-enforced limit on what can happen inside L: a count, not a time.
Not bounded: L itself, still unmeasured (ADR-0032 §4).
Only for an honest watermark. A colluding Observer heartbeats, reports a watermark and finds nothing, all its own assertions: the bound is empty under collusion.
An Observer that is not there produces the same observable as a clean system
Closed: no live lease or no heartbeat within T_obs, so its Thinker's effects are refused
Its heartbeats do not reach the mechanism
Closed: heard(o) goes stale, and R3 refuses
Alive, heartbeating, falling behind (accelerator contention, an availability attack ADR-0008 named)
Closed by the watermark: presence without progress fails condition 3 (M_MARK: testing the time and not the watermark lets a starved Observer pass)
Heartbeats, reports a watermark and finds nothing

Open. Cover, as far as there is one: lineage independence (ADR-0016 §5, ADR-0035, Proposed) and the subtract-only correlated-miss test. The residual-risk statement must say: detection fails open against a colluding
Observer (unwritten; G7 §8)

text.tspan: Degeneracies (record-level entries; both void no safety theorem and state their losses in prose)

svg.text: Mechanism (a policy-floor entry and a
grant-path check, ADR-0023 §6a)
Coupling in Run: R3-observer-live and the cross-round grant condition in
force → absent
Every Run admit has a live, keeping-up cell Observer, and every earlier
round was read before the next was granted
None. Properties lost: UnreadBounded, and (A1) UnreadEffectsBounded. The in-round bound loosens from K to R; across rounds the backlog grows by up to R a round. Detection
fails open against a dead, partitioned or starved Observer. Keeps the round bound
No participant changes type
Mechanism (ADR-0023 §6a)
Effects counted and recorded: Actuate and Report → Report only
Every effect-bearing admit advances the sequence and leaves a record an
Observer can mark
None. Property lost: UnreadBounded for invocations: bounded by R, not K, in a round; unbounded across rounds. Fails open against a starved Observer for every principal that does not
report. The reference as it stood on 2026.09.29; composes with D-0039-1 with no loss beyond the union
No participant changes type

Composition (ADR-0039 §7). Under coupling a cell with no Observer makes no Run admits, so ADR-0037 D-0037-1 and ADR-0038 D-0038-1 are usable in Run only together with D-0039-1; declared together, no theorem is lost beyond the union.

text.tspan: §6 · The Observer is on Run's hot path, for liveness not judgment

svg.text: Latency: when the Observer lags by more than K the Thinker waits; a new round waits until the last is read.
Availability: a cell's availability is the product of its Thinker's and its Observer's. Extra Observers raise it: any one live Observer is
enough.
Throughput: heartbeats are admits on the consensus log, one per T_obs per Observer.
R3 couples break-glass too: an emergency path waits on a dead Observer. Ratified as written (B14), "the first thing a reviewer should
reopen" (ToO §5.4; G7 item 49).
A Byzantine Observer can stop its own cell by withholding heartbeats: availability, within one cell.
None of these is a term in W + L + D < T_irrev.

text.tspan: §1 (R3) · The placeholders: chosen 2026.09.29 for order of magnitude, none measured
Draft, not ratified · values file: DRAFT · PLACEHOLDERS · not ratified
What a deployment sets it from

svg.text: values file (floor/genesis-values.json)
About five propagation windows W (~1 s at the archetype), ten of the reference's lease margins (500 ms), well inside a lease TTL (120 s in the smoke test). Read with the
asymmetric margin
The Observer's measured heartbeat cadence and the
margin
values file
T_obs at roughly one admit per second, rounded up, so an Observer keeping pace never blocks. K = 0 is the quarantine hold (finding 1)
The Observer's measured lag; the tolerated unread
backlog
mechanism parameters (I21; dev-init.sh)
The reference's existing dev value
Termination and state-space size (ADR-0022 §3)
mechanism parameters, per domain
Run actions are effect-bearing and Run rounds short: 64 admits at about one per second is a minute, the order of a Run lease's TTL
The same, per Run's alphabet

R is not in the values file: a mechanism parameter, digested into every admit. Relaxing T_obs or K is an anchor issuance and a promotion; tightening is an ordinary promotion. Each is a deployment or rung choice declared under ADR-0023 §6, not the pattern's value. Measured values are open (G7 item 47).

text.tspan: ADR-0032 · The clock model: clocks buy liveness, never safety; intervals are trusted by failure direction
§1 · Epoch fencing carries safety without reading a clock

svg.text: An action under a stale epoch is rejected because the epoch does not match, not because a timer expired. An expired lease its holder still
believes in is not a containment violation.
So clock misbehaviour costs availability or detection lag, never containment: a fast clock evicts early and subtracts; a slow one delays
an eviction the fence would still catch.
§3 · No safety decision reads a clock supplied by a principal; a timestamp in a payload is cognitive content (open:
NoAdmitOnPrincipalTime, a TLA+ property).
§6 decides no drift bound and no wall-clock behaviour: neither can reach containment.
A local monotonic clock, read with an asymmetric margin that elapses early, so
clock error removes authority rather than extending it
Lease expiry, passive e-stop, vote timeout
T_obs (heartbeat freshness) is this row
Trusted time: a signed, attested time source outside the principal
Break-glass TTL, Persona expiry, re-attestation intervals
No time source is a row: trusted time is refused by ADR-0045 §6. R8 (break-glass
TTL) stays pending (G7 item 8); T_persona runs on the local clock (item 62)
Effect propagation window, about a second at the archetype
Proven
Observer detection latency
Unmeasured; coupling bounds a count next to it, not L
Human response budget
Promised
Time from emission until the effect is irreversible
Declared per effect class
No effect class enumerated yet

The sum is the property; the ordering W < L < D is demoted to a description of magnitudes. Where T_irrev is smaller than any budget, the answer is not a faster clock: the effect must not be expressible in the alphabet at all. L and D keep their 09.12-onward meanings (§5).

text.tspan: What was checked (each property broken by its mutation, small constants), and what is proved

svg.text: M_NOCOUPLE: the check dropped
Breaks, and takes UnreadBounded with it: D-0039-1 as stated
UnreadBounded (over all rounds)
M_MARK: tests heartbeat time, not watermark · M_ROUNDS: coverage not carried across rounds (the record before R1)
Each breaks only UnreadBounded; M_ROUNDS with the trace "round 2 granted while round 1 unread"
CorrelatorNeverGates (an ENABLED predicate)
M_CORR: the correlator coupled
Breaks only §4
UnreadEffectsBounded, SealCountsEffects
M_EMITSEQ: only Report advances the sequence (the reference before ADR-0042)
Breaks both and nothing else (K=1, R=4, two rounds)
M_COUPLEALL: Consult coupled
Breaks only it
Breaks it

Proved since 2026.10.02 (ADR-0039, ADR-0041, ADR-0042 B25; ADR-0046 §4): Coupling_proof.tla (320 obligations) and RunCoupling_proof.tla (469) prove every property above for every K, R and round bound, each not under the mutations that break it: UnreadBounded not under M_MARK, M_ROUNDS, M_NOCOUPLE; UnreadEffectsBounded not under M_EMITSEQ, M_MARK, M_ROUNDS, M_NOCOUPLE; SealCountsEffects not under M_EMITSEQ alone (the

binding table had named M_ROUNDS, which never touches a seal: ADR-0046 §5). The form proved after an admit is seq − mark ≤ K, from the strict check at the guard. The rows above stay with TLC; neither proof is a claim about the reference.

At the reference (R4): every refusal seen to fire: no Observer lease, no heartbeat, a dishonest heartbeat, a backlog of K, presence without progress, staleness after T_obs, a round-2 grant while round 1 is unread; one Build promotion stalled for coverage and completed by a heartbeat to the seal. Not realized: W(p) as an ACL and the gate-side K < R check (G8 item 46); a scripted cell Observer (item 45); how Observer rounds are laid out against Thinker rounds
(finding 3; item 60).

Sources: ADR-0039 §1–§8, Options, Findings 1–4, History R1–R5, A1, B14, B20; ADR-0042 §1–§5, §7, §8 (B20; §6 Proposed); ADR-0041 §2; ADR-0032 §1–§6 (B5); ADR-0007; ADR-0024 §2; ADR-0038 §2; floor/genesis-floor.cedar R3-observer-live (DRAFT floor); floor/genesis-values.json (DRAFT, placeholders); spec/Coupling.tla, spec/RunCoupling.tla and their 2026.09.29 results; spec/Coupling_proof.tla, spec/RunCoupling_proof.tla and their 2026.10.02 proof results;
